t: After consuming 3 chickens, 3 cows, 3 sheeps, weak automata core will be transformed to husbandry automata core!$(p)In addition to be more powerful weak automata core variant, seems, this soul also provide abilities to interact with animals!
虚弱自动机核心吞噬3只鸡、3头牛、3只羊后，将转化为农牧业自动机核心！$(p)除作为更强大的虚弱自动机核心变体外，该灵魂似乎还赋予海龟与动物交互的能力！
In additions to weak automata core abilities, this core also allow to interact with animals and even transfer them inside!$(p)But be aware, any stored animal will be lost after turtle is broken.
除继承虚弱自动机核心的能力外，该核心还可与动物交互，甚至能将动物收入其中！$(p)但请注意：一旦海龟被破坏，所有已收纳的动物都将丢失。
